synthesis: Build 'Bird's Eye' — an org-wide, admin-facing view of all Scout drivers' activity that reuses the existing Scout map UI (black/coral look, map style, layer toggles, historical date-range, bottom stats bar) but scoped to the whole org instead of one driver, with a driver selector defaulting to everyone. Today Scout is a driver-authenticated Vue SPA whose every /api/scout/* endpoint is scoped to the single logged-in driver's kit. The work is (1) a new admin-authed, org-scoped data surface and (2) a Bird's-Eye orchestration of the existing Scout Vue components that renders N drivers at once.

scope.summary: New full-screen Scout-style SPA route (admin-only, Scout-gated, 'Scout' nav group) backed by a new admin org-wide API group. Reuses ScannerMap/MapShell/MapStatsBar/controls; adds a DriverSelector and per-driver markers+trails. New org-wide live-position aggregator + org-wide live-trails + org-wide stats; scan-paths/heatmaps reuse already-org-wide queries.

tests.what_it_pins: Gating: non-admin or CLARITY_SCOUT-off is denied; admin+flag gets 200 on the route + endpoints.
Org-wide scoping: endpoints return only the caller's org's kits; selector kit_ids subset filters; empty kit_ids = all org kits; cross-org isolation.
OrgLivePositionsQuery shape: latest-per-mapping, lower(kit_mapping) match, geo decode, 24h cutoff, keyed by kit.

qa_hint.seed_scenario: One org with ~3-4 Scout-enrolled kits (kit_settings rows + assigned users), each with recent sc_positions points (varied lat/lng/heading), today's kit_scan_paths buckets, and a handful of Live/Staging hits — so all drivers' dots, trails, paths, heatmaps, and summed stats are visible; plus a second org with its own kit to prove cross-org isolation.

escalate.reason: Feature is large but the material design questions (view shell, auth surface, live scope, base branch) are all resolved with the human this session; remaining work is well-grounded in existing reusable code. Size, not ambiguity, is the main risk — handled by the Phase 3 subtask DAG.
